scientific_integrity: The exact formulas and Jordan-rank inversion have symbolic proofs; exhaustive finite computation corroborates, not replaces, those proofs. The July 2026 wreath-product paper could not be read beyond its abstract and remains a stated priority risk. No external independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Split finite groups with a known elementary-abelian normal subgroup and a cyclic prime-order unipotent action, for odd primes. Order and prime are known for reconstruction. Not arbitrary p-groups or arbitrary Engel-word distributions.
title: Short Engel probability profiles recover modular Jordan types
